part1.browser: Google Chrome Headless (Chromium Engine v134+ on Windows 11)
part1.supabaseProjectType: Development (PostgreSQL DDL schema with RLS & RPC; active in-memory REST sync store)

part2.action: Register synthetic donor Kavitha Raman (O+, age 28) and open Donor Portal
part2.expected: Donor registered successfully, donor dashboard displays with availability status and blood group badge
part2.actual: Donor portal rendered with active donor profile, O+ status badge, and scheduled appointment controls

part2.action: Unverified hospital (hosp-pending) attempts to submit emergency blood request
part2.expected: Request rejected with 403 Forbidden due to pending institution verification
part2.actual: HTTP 403 Forbidden returned: "Hospital registration is pending administrator verification. Emergency blood request creation refused.". Request refused.

part2.action: Verified hospital (RGGGH) creates emergency request for 4 units of O- blood
part2.expected: Request persisted with case reference, status "Open", notifications broadcasted
part2.actual: HTTP 201 Created. Request ID: req-1792722344589, Ref: EMR-2026-2848, Status: Open, 6 donors notified.

part2.action: Submit blood request with negative units (-5) and invalid blood group
part2.expected: Validation error returned with HTTP 400 Bad Request
part2.actual: HTTP 400 Bad Request returned with error: "Invalid blood group: INVALID_GROUP". Request blocked.

part2.action: Reserve 2 units of compatible A+ blood from Indian Red Cross Society (bank-1)
part2.expected: Blood bank response accepted, inventory decremented atomically, tracking number issued
part2.actual: Reserved 2 units. Available units reduced from 23 to 21. Dispatch Tracking: DISPATCH-347982

part2.action: Execute donor matching engine for O- request (req-1792722344589) with zero bank stock
part2.expected: Matching engine returns ranked shortlist of compatible donors ordered by distance and eligibility
part2.actual: Shortlist generated with 25 donors evaluated. Compatible groups: [O-]. Top match: Kavita S. (O-, 4.5 km).

part2.action: Verify exclusion and screening reasons for incompatible and ineligible donors
part2.expected: Incompatible blood groups flagged isCompatible=false; ineligible donors flagged isEligible=false
part2.actual: 19 donors flagged incompatible (e.g. A+, B+ vs requested O-); 2 donors flagged ineligible (e.g. donor-7 age 71 > 65 limit).

part2.action: Verify distance-based ascending order among compatible and eligible donors
part2.expected: Eligible donors ranked in strictly ascending order of distance from hospital
part2.actual: Rank 1: Kavita S. (4.5 km); Rank 2: Karthik S. (5.6 km). All 6 eligible donors ordered by proximity.

part2.action: Donor Karthik Subramanian (donor-1) pledges to donate for request
part2.expected: Pledge recorded as "Attending", request unitsPledged incremented, hospital notified
part2.actual: HTTP 201 Created. Pledge status: "Attending", unitsPledged updated to 1. Hospital notification dispatched.

part2.action: Simulate response timer expiration and trigger emergency escalation handler
part2.expected: Search radius expanded from 10 km to 50 km and State Admin notified of crisis
part2.actual: HTTP 200 OK. Search radius widened to 50 km. Escalated to: State Blood Transfusion Council Admin. Audit log and admin notification recorded.

part2.action: Two concurrent hospital requests compete for the last 2 units of B- at Rotary Blood Bank (bank-2)
part2.expected: First request locks and reserves units; second request is rejected with stock exhaustion error
part2.actual: Request 1: HTTP 201 (Reserved 2 units). Request 2: HTTP 400 "Insufficient stock. Only 0 units of B- available.". Units reserved for only one.

part2.action: Donor 1 (Karthik) attempts to retrieve private health and contact data of Donor 2 (Dr. Priya)
part2.expected: Access Denied with HTTP 403 Forbidden under Supabase RLS privacy isolation policy
part2.actual: HTTP 403 Forbidden returned: "Access Denied: Cannot view private donor record belonging to another user (RLS Policy Violation).". Data access blocked.

part2.action: Hospital attempts to directly modify blood bank inventory (inv-1 availableUnits -> 999)
part2.expected: Action rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden under inventory security policy
part2.actual: HTTP 403 Forbidden returned: "Access Denied: Hospitals and donors are not authorized to modify blood bank inventory (RLS Policy Violation).". Inventory integrity preserved.

part2.action: Transition request req-1792722344589 to "Fulfilled" and verify notification dispatch
part2.expected: Relevant users (hospital lead & pledged donors) receive status update notification
part2.actual: Request transitioned to Fulfilled. Notification system dispatched updates; donor notifications active (79 total notifications present).
